tei:div.tei:p: 347)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rigs gcig rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas bsdus pa ye shes lam bzang bzhugs so: na mo padma kā ra ye: gang dag gsang sngags lam zhugs skyes bu yis: thugs mchog sems dpa' chen po sgrub pa'i thabs: ye shes lam bzang 'di ru bstan par bya: sa ma ya: dang po skyabs su 'gro dang sems bskyed ni: sgo gsum dad pa'i ngang nas 'di skad brjod: na mo: bla med bla ma dkon mchog gsum: rigs 'dus sems dpar skyabs su mchi: bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can kun: byang chub lam 'god sems bskyed do: lan gsum brjod mthar dngos gzhi ni: āḥ smra bsam brjod bral 'od gsal dbyings: phyogs mtha' las 'das kun tu snang: thugs rje'i rang rtsal zhing khams su: lhun grub rang gdangs gzhal yas dbus: padma zla ba rgyas pa'i steng: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: rig pa mi 'gyur don gyi lha: dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: dkar gsal zhi 'dzum mtshan dpes brgyan: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa yis: rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar gtod: g.yon pas dril bu dku la brten: longs spyod rgyan rdzogs gzi 'od 348)'bar: zhabs gnyis skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs: ye shes lnga ldan 'od klong du: snang stong sgyu ma'i lha skur bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros dbyings bzhugs ye shes lha: spyan drangs dam ye gnyis med gyur: lha dang rang snang mjal phyag 'tshal: snang srid rnam dag mchod pa 'bul: gzung 'dzin bral bas phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: snang stong gnyis med ye shes lha'i: thugs kar padma zla gdan la: thugs srog hūm̐ yig dkar po'i mthar: sngags kyi phreng ba bar med 'khor: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus sngags phreng la thim pas: sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du rol: oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐: zhes pa brgya stong khri 'bum dang: bye ba bzlas pas tshad du 'khyol:

thun mtshams yi ge brgya pa ni: brgya'am lnga bcu rtsa lnga sogs: gzhan gyi mi tshig ma 'dres par: lhar snang gsal brtan dag pa'i ngang: 'dir brtson sgrib pa kun las grol: bden rdzunalag tu longs dang gsal: the tshom med do sa ma ya: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gyis: thub par srungs shig brda thim rgya: : zhes pa 'di yang shākya'i dge btsun 'dul ba 'dzin pa tshe dbang gis nan che'i bskul ngo ma ldog tsam du bai phug mkha' 'gro yang rdzong nas dus mtha'i sprang mo bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes nyams 349)chos yig ris su bris pa'o// mthar mchod cing bstod pa ni: oṃ: ye shes lnga las sprul pa yi: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra arghaṃ= shapda rū pa= sparshe ma hā sarba pañtsha a mṛ ta bha liṃ ta rakta bo dhi tsitta la khā hi: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i dpal: skyon bral mtshan dang dpe byad ldan: mi 'gyur rdo rje lta bu'i sku: sems dpa' chen po khyed la bstod: dge 'dis 'khor ba dong sprugs nas: mngon dga'i zhing la spyod par shog: ces pa 'di yang dad ldan shākya'i dge btsun tshe dbang gis bskul ngor bde ba'i rdo rjes nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// 350)
